rows.falsifier: Discovery of a comprehensive survey documenting the internal design and self-correction mechanisms of a broad, representative sample of the 300+ known cognitive architectures.
rows.reason: Source excerpt confirms that 'a small group of architectures such as ACT-R, Soar, CLARION, ICARUS, EPIC, LIDA and a few others are present in most sources, and all other projects are only brieﬂy mentioned in on-line catalogs.'
rows.statement: The literature on cognitive architectures is heavily skewed toward a small set of established models like ACT-R and Soar, leaving a large majority of projects with only minimal documentation.
